items.title: Honesty fix pack — standings 1.2.2 · mesh chat · intention × grade

items.title: dViNE CodEX 1.1 — statistical freeze + lab chronicle
items.body: Industry Silesia = field baseline (brotli-11 4.21× · zstd-3 ~39 MB/s). OmniWave lossless freeze ~3.13–3.60×. Float path diagnostic-only. Books II & XI expand wrong-engine honesty and Chamber vs public faces.

items.title: Suite pricing redesigned: free 1 GB, then ~1.5¢/GB
items.body: Freemium showcase cap (first 1 GiB free per job). Paid usage ~1.5¢/GB (0.8¢ after 50 GB over free) — far under typical cloud egress. Old ~$2/9GB slogan retired.
